scope: Six predeclared points over the existing 27-patch pilot; diagnostic comparisons, not calibrated planetary analogue ground truth. All defaults are global, with no geographic exclusions or per-site tuning. Before reproduces native slope only with 10 degree tolerance and no coverage gate.
